Great app but. It's a great app, but when I find an app that appears free, but you go to do something simple, they lock it behind a premium subscription, immediate 2 stars. 

I would prefer to use the app in its entirety, then if I enjoy it I would donate. Similar to what I do with Khan Academy. 

This app has the audacity to charge you $65 ever 6 months? 😂 Come on.
Good Schedule. Easy to use
Everything you need. Love the app except I am more of a minimalist and since I use it on my small screen phone, I wish I could minimize some graphics

Misleading subscription model. The free version will lock up after you make 25 activities. I was perfectly happy using the app with just the free features, and after I’d settled into a good rhythm of using it, it locked the app and told me to pay. The app is good quality, but don’t download it unless you’re ready to pay for the subscription from the start.

Not for me. I only had this app for a little while. I found it so confusing and hard to use. I can’t figure out where anything is or what any of the buttons mean. More than once I got stuck somewhere and had to exit and reload the app to get back to the main page. It seems like it has a lot of features, but I couldn’t figure them out and most of them seem to be the ones you have to pay for, and you never know the at until you clicked on them and the ad screen pops up.
Pros and cons. This is a pretty helpful app to plan, the only thing is that it is hard to use and understand fully
Forces You to Create an Account, Paywalls. Impossible to use without giving them an email and paywalled features

Love it, but it’s glitchy!. I love this app tremendously! I love that I can sync my calendars - work and personal, love the goal setting, and the ability to create sub-tasks (this was major for me)! The only issues I have with this app are, it crashes for no reason from time to time. I haven’t lost anything as a result, but it is highly annoying for it to crash unexpectedly. The other issue, which is even more frustrating, is there’s no option to delete an event, or task, or occurrence. I created a routine just testing everything out, and now I can’t delete it, I can’t delete the sub-tasks or anything. Seems the only way around this is to repurpose what you can’t delete, but if you cant, you’re stuck with having a task, sub-task, event, or routine that you don’t need. Any idea on when you guys will get something as simple as a delete feature? 
Otherwise, love the app!
-
Love the app, hate the price. It’s ridiculously overpriced.
Productivity. I feel so productive each day!!!
Visionary. Simply the best app to help ensure your success!

Great Product. Probably the best I have ever used. After searching relentlessly for something decent because I was tired of downloading apps that just disappointed, I found this one and It’s like they understood how my brain worked! 

Superior job at building San app that is intuitive and easy to navigate. Helps me become more actionable by guiding me to break up all my steps as a piece of the whole. Every time I thought to myself “I wish it did this or that”, to my delight, I realized they already thought of it and made it happen. 

Amazing app. Wish I had food this years ago!
Unrealistic. Why would I pay $120 a year, $60 every 6 months for app that does the same thing TicTic does? Really?!

My Daily Planner in my pocket. I have used, and continue to use a number of task lists, to do lists, calendars, and such. I like the feel of this app as it puts the functionality of all in one platform. 

This is my “strategic planning central”, other apps are quick references to task lists, checklists and to do lists so I I don’t clutter my strategic planning this system works nicely for me. I can recommend this app.

Great app. This app is the only one that allowed me to create custom routines and modify them over time. It is a must for my chaotic life. The only thing I dislike is the new update for sub tasks. It is an extra tap to complete them.

Love - but expensive. This app is so unique in all that it will let you do from habit tracking, to breaking down goals, to being mindful. I love it. I’ve used it for months, but lately the monthly fee is bothering me. I’m on the search for something else, but if you don’t mind the fee - there is no app like this. I’m going to have to find two to replace this ONE.

Great App. I really loved the App. It had pretty much everything that I needed to help me personally and professionally on a daily basis. The only little detail that I disliked was that the on the calendar, whatever day was the 1st, that’s where the calendar started (Ex. If the first was on a Tuesday, the calendar started Tuesday through not like majority where they start on a Sunday)

Unreliable. I love the software and it is very helpful. Starting last night and still today I am unable to launch the app. I was keeping everything in there.

This is the second time I’ve had problems with it.

I am considering a different app or going back to paper. I feel lost without all my notes.

Amazing app.. This app literally has everything I one needs to organize their life. The only issue I’m having as of the past few weeks is being able to add goals. I have the pro version which gives unlimited goals. For some reason new goals that I make will duplicate after closing and reopening app and will completely delete the goal after closing and reopening a second time. If this problem is solved I will change my review to 5 stars. Until then I have to give 4 stars, I’m paying for unlimited goals, etc. But not getting what I paid for, unsatisfactory.

Very Busy. I doubt you will be focused or get much done with this app, because it takes too many touches and reading of options and entry fields in order to enter any info or take any action. 

Better structure, and hiding most entry behind icons, would be big improvements. I just could not get past the tech friction. 

I suppose if your iPad is always attached to a keyboard it might be easier to skip over all that stuff, but that kind of defeats the purpose of a mobile app. And you still have to see all the irrelevant choices.
Buggy. Keeps deleting new entries!

Sick of apps not working with password managers. When an application requires that you create a password and usernane and doesn’t allow you to paste or generate passwords with the built in capabilities or extended capabilities it is useless to me. 

Cut/paste isn’t allowed so I can’t make it anywhere and on the account creation screen it inexplicably limited you to putting the password on the bottom password but not the first one since it makes you enter twice. None of the iOS cut/paste prompts come up so unable to copy and paste it out of it. 

If you require an account it’s mandatory you get this working. Especially in an app that wants money for features this isn’t adware this is a software package we want to give you cash to use. 

Can’t get past the start screen because can’t create a secure login really hard to evaluate and pay money for something.

Premium way too expensive. I absolutely love the app and you can for sure get by with the free version, but $100 a year for a few features like unlimited goals and habits is a little much. I think a more reasonable and comparable price would be $40-50 annually. Other than that, great app, but way to expensive
No iOS widgets. There are no widgets.
Buena App. Es una de las mejores aplicaciones que utilizado para realizar mis metas, es muy completa y muy sencilla de manejar mi única queja es que no la han adaptado para smartwatch.
Dream Planner App. After many long years of trying many different ways to plan my days and stay on track, this is everything I’ve been looking for. Must try.
Charged me without my acceptance. Charged my 6 months without my acceptance

I want to love this app!!!. There are so many features I love about this app but for productivity purposes the daily calendar and tasks are not user friendly. The calendars that sync with apple calendar are not color coded which is a necessary for me and I want to be able to see my tasks while my calendar is open. I don’t see the purpose of showing the calendar on the right side and listing the same events on the left side in the same view. I feel the tasks should be listed on the left. The only other thing I could see that would make this the perfect app would be to sync with apple reminders!

Outstanding. I highly recommend the premium. I am so productive while using this app and I make sure I am scheduling and setting aside time for things that matter to not only my business goals, but my family and personal goals too. FANTASTIC!

Love the notifications. I’m sure lots of people think multiple notifications a day are annoying (and you can adjust that in settings). But I personally love it so much. From “can you start X now?” to “can you try to finish Y before the end of the day?” it puts me in a productive mindset and reminds me to focus when I inevitably get distracted throughout the day. 

I like how I can visually plan my day (separating tasks into morning, afternoon and evening, and highlighting high-priority tasks), and it’s easy to move tasks from one day to another if you didn’t get to them. I also like that it connects to my calendar (so it automatically autofills events into the correct section of my Today window). 

I was looking for an app that would nudge me to complete certain tasks throughout the day, and I found it. Thanks!
Excelencia. Muy excelente
Can’t create acct. Can’t even create a new account - app is unusable

Rating. This app is absolutely wonderful. 

Now I have no excuses. If I fail, if I do not complete an activity, it is all on me. 

With this app covering any and all possible going wrong issues, including distractions, there just is no room available for failing at anything.

This app has completely transformed my workflow. I own a small software development firm. This app is perfect for me when I’m building software by myself. The milestones feature and the activities/sub activities is phenomenal. Every day, I begin by analyzing what I have to do, adding activities, and then proceeding to work. This streamlines my entire process without being overloaded. Every time I have a new idea, i add a new activity. THANK YOU!

Not able to change color. Overall the app is impressive, however, I was not able to change my time bars in different colors. Color in such an important feature to improve clarity and productivity. Please make it more visible and easier to change. The user guide was not helpful as well... I would not use it anymore if I’m not able to change the color.
App Cool. This app cool
great app. The app is life changing. It makes me more productive and gives me motivation to accomplish my goals
Just downloaded. I have an IPad Pro 2020 and I am connected via WiFi, but I can sign in because the app says “no network or connection”.
Life Changing!. Awesome! Lots of features for organization, goal setting, planning, to do lists, timers, calendar sync, diary, mood tracker, and more! I’m gonna get so much done!
Really helps!. Love this app! Does everything I need it to. Super customizable and easy to use. Really helps organize and keep you on track for completing activities and goals.

Better than others. I really like the different sections of the app and how you can put meaning behind a task. It helps you complete it bu digging deeper into the reasons, which has helped a lot. Can’t wait for more upgrades and improvements.
Great app. I love this app so much !!!

I truly had to call a shrink after trying this. I'm sure the developer didn't *intend* to cause me to consider this app as yet another, recent sign that I'll simply remain (what I consider) a useless person, without a chance of accomplishing anything else of any importance in this lifetime.

This app's absurd glitches are frustrating as hell (to a normally laid-back, calm person). It currently has extremely time-wasting, motivation-sapping glitches.

I imagine the developer is a nice person who diligently tries to create/improve this app that's based on potentially helpful concepts though I *adamantly admit I was disheartened & thought, "Does this person consider the app users fools?" because there's a link in the app leading you to an option to PURCHASE $300/hour (before 33% off sale so $200/HOUR) LIFE "COACHING" SESSIONS, with NO MENTION EVEN OF THE CREDENTIALS OF SAID "COACH." Sure, sign me up for at least a couple. Why not.

Anyway, back to the "app": What in the freaking world is wrong with this thing? It first seemed GREAT, but when I was finished with an (engaging & "would have been helpful") process of "goal-setting," I turned to another app activity. When I later tried to find the goal stuff I'd poured my heart, time, & energy into, everything I'd written had VANISHED. I tried again, two more times, thinking maybe I'd missed some button I was supposed to press or SOMEthing but this glitch simply occurred repeatedly. Then, hanging in there, I decided to try to use the "Activities" part of the app as a sort of a work-around, & the same happened! Plus, although the developer states something above about having fixed something with iCal, nothing at all was saved on mine.

My iPad is completely up to date with everything, it's the 2019 7th gen., & every other app I use is working fine. I just wish my mood (& maybe the next couple hours) were not now f***ed up. I couldn't afford that today at all. Maybe I should try one of those online therapy apps for "further support," but I feel a bit sick & have decided to go back to bed.

First App I’ve Ever Paid This Much For. Too bad there’s not an option for 1 million stars!!!
I’ve never bought an app over $3 EVER, except for this one. It was well worth every penny and then some!!! 

Every morning I would get up and write my To Do list on a notepad, which took time. 
With this app everything automatically resets for me every day so I can spend more time on getting things done. It also has a built in timer so I can track how much time I spend on my tasks. 

It also has an amazing Goals & Notepad feature. It’s wonderfully organized and not cluttered at all. 

I also LOVE the fact that you let people try it (with 2 reoccurring tasks) before they buy. 

I swear, y’all really outdid yourselves! 
I’m telling EVERYONE about this amazing app!

Deleting & duplicating. This app layout and task organizing was awesome until it started doubling my tasks and then deleting them rendering the whole app basically unusable. Had to rewrite my subtasks many times and the glitch remained.

Unimpressed. I tried this and was unimpressed
Too complicated to set up on a phone or tablet and no tutorial
Once I picked three goals I couldn’t check out any other goals without going pro. But I couldn’t unpick any of the goals I had selected so I could go back to exploring options. 

It seems like a good idea but clearly not very well tested by people not familiar with this stuff

Devil in the Details. When life seems to have so many blurred lines and there doesn’t seem like there are enough hours in the day this app is sure to save the day. If you are one that has time sensitive task and objectives and or people to supervise this app will revolutionize your decision making process. If you use it and refer back to it often you will save time and be afforded the luxury of compartmentalizing priority, secondary and so on. Let’s face it. We are in 2020 and you must automate your life so you can have time for life.

No Longer Syncs to IOS Reminders 😡. Nothing is more frustrating than when a developer takes away a function of an app without notice. There was nothing in the “What’s new” portion of this page that warned that this function would go away. It really pisses off current users and negatively affects a developers credibility.

I liked using the evening routine of using this app to plan my next day and add activities that would show up the native IOS Reminders app. Granted reminders were only unidirectional, ie reminders added to the Reminders app could not be imported to this app, but at least they were there. 

Syncing with Reminders is useful because the Reminders app is integrated with Siri and Shortcuts. I use those reminders with another calendar app that I like better than the native IOS calendar or the calendar feature on this app. I had a system I could easily manage and now it is broken.

In other words, just having this app send a reminder through notifications is not good enough and shows that the developer lacks imagination when it comes to use cases. It’s a shame, because this was the best goal setting app I have found, but now it’s usefulness is incredibly decreased.

Glitches but great support. I originally rate this app a 1. I’m changing my rating of this app because of the quick responses from the support team. 
“Recently it wiped every event, due dates, appointments, off the app. It’s the only place I had stored that information so I immediately contacted them. It was easily fixed by logging out & logging back in. However, now I am logged out with no way of logging back in. The app shows an error message saying that I have no network even though i do”
That being said the app is very clear and concise. It is my go to for be productive and staying on top of class work. The prompt responses for support make it a worthy product despite the glitches.
This app is Good for beginning.. Thus
App has a lot of glitches. I spent 20 mins of my life making miles stones for weight loss for 12 weeks only to find the app jumbles it and glitches the dates. It was disappointing.

Great App. I tried several different apps, many of which charge money after the free trial. This one has been the best and it’s free! Keeps me organized, syncs to google calendar. (Edit: app is not free. Can do pretty much the same thing on google calendar so I will just continue to do that... not worth paying for.)
Everyday use. I use this every day to prioritize day! It helps me to focus on what’s important. I love the journaling feature! It helps me to capture my thoughts and ideas throughout the day.

I really like it.. I don’t know why there was no response to my email suggestions. Were they received?

Here are my suggestions:
1- set countdown to full length...ex. 40 min would be 1/4 way through at 10 min.
2- On repetition, I need how many days apart... example... 12 days apart. It would be an added bonus to exclude certain days... like Sun.
3- When I try to add an activity to a calendar, it says I need to select the time. I’d prefer for it to show as all-day in these cases. Otherwise, it doesn’t sync. :-)
4- I set the duration to all day.. But is not allowing the activity to be saved. However, the activities from my Family shared calendar is being brought in, but I can only see it under the calendar view if I scroll to midnight. The daily view with items doesn’t show it. It would be cool to show it. :-)

I really like this app!

Wish the Free Version Wasn’t Just a Demo. I really, really enjoyed everything about this app. The functionality was great, the activities and goal linking were really motivating, and the evening routine was great for ending the day in a thoughtful note. Previously, I had rated this app five stars.

And then I hit my forty activity cap that comes in the free version. The app is essentially broken now unless I subscribe to the pro plan (which is a monthly fee). Honestly, the app is good enough that I AM considering going pro...but the fact that the free version essentially had a limited lifespan before basically forcing you into the paid plan by restricting the app’s usefulness is pretty disappointing. Would much rather have had the functions just limited to free version/paid version features, vs a free version that stops working as well (ie. Like Evernote, Todoist, Trello, etc). Leaves me feeling pretty let down as a consumer by an app I had been really enjoying...

Would have been nice had it worked. I used this app when it was new. It was simple, but effective. For some reason I got out of the habit of using it. After hearing about the updates I decided to try it again. It was fine until I got to the goals page. I tried to set a goal and it said that I had reached my limit of three goals. When I tried to see the goals it only showed one. When I tried again to add a goal it said I had reached the limit of three. I deactivated the account, thinking that would clear it so I could start over. No. I couldn't re-register or reactivate the account. I then got an email saying that if I had a paid membership I should cancel payment. I had planned to. Thank goodness I didn't spend money on this!
Love this app. This app really helps me stay on track with everything. Sometimes my mind runs so wild and I forget a lot of things but with this app I get a lot more work done.
Disappointed and Frustrated!. I have asked for my password to be reset. I NEVER get a response even though I have tried multiple times over multiple days. Very frustrating to say the least!

Worth the Money. I love this app! It has helped me become more accountable for my goals and actions 🔌

*Can we get an option to select a specific time frame for Actions? I.e. Every 2nd Saturday ect
Also, the option to select a double reminder like iPhone calendar 🤞🤞🤞
Just what was looking for!. Love it and thankfully great! 🤩

Confusing, poorly designed, and exploitive.. I set a goal and could not find it, so I set the goal again. Once I had set the goal a second time, it showed me a list of goals, including the first one, which had gotten lost due to a poorly designed GUI... and it gave me no option to delete that goal. Then it counted the duplicate goal caused by poor interface design toward my three free goals, after which I would need to pay. It’s absurd, and offensive, and I feel the company owes me money. “But you didn’t pay anything!” I WASTED VALUABLE TIME, because these programmers were thoughtless and mercenary.

JUST WHAT I WAS LOOKING FOR. As an entrepreneur, I am so busy and overwhelmed with juggling all the things I need to get done in order to take my start-up to another level while managing my life in general. What I found that I needed were "clear plans." 

I just cannot keep all the structure of going from A to B, C, and D in my head. Writing it down/typing as notes or calendar tasks wasn't working. 

This app organizes me. I can write all tasks down to the details. Literally, I wrote about 50 tasks that were on my mind after opening this app. What a relief!

Previously, I downloaded four goal-oriented apps. They were helpful, but not complete. 

This app is what I needed. 

It is more than just a goal app, it is a business planner to take my vision to the next level, a real GTD app.

Hooray and thank you!

UPDATE: 11/27/15
The latest update fixed the bugs they were having. HOORAY!!!!

You have no idea how helpful this app is and with the newest update, I can add images to my goals and get a PDF version of my goals via email. The newest update is wonderful! Thank you. Your app is still the best for productivity.

2/21/19
I am still using this awesome app!🎉

Best Productivity App I’ve ever used. Exactly what i have been wanting. Can’t think of a way it could be. enter.

Although devs, when creating a new Activity - i would love to choose from the created templates i had available for choosing my first!
It’s good but..... Now it has a monthly subscription. I wish I could just purchase it once.
Keeping organized. I like have notes, goals and planning in one app. Thanks
Very thought out. This app is unlike any calendar or organizing app. It keeps you accountable to your own goals and priorities in a very organized way.
Nice Look & Helpful. Good app so far! Keeps you engaged with its questions in order to keep you on track! Thank you so much!

Great app, but several options are missing or broken. Great app, but several options are missing or broken. I’ve emailed the developer several times. They kept saying they would address the bugs, but 1 year later they still haven’t.

Effective App. I really enjoy this app a lot. It is very engaging and it takes practice after practice to be committed to this app. It is definitely helping me to build and stay connected to my morning habits, as well as my important task throughout the day. I also enjoy how personal you can get through opening up about your goals in all different areas of your life. Whether it be Work, Financial, love and spirituality. 
One tiny issue I have with the app, is that is randomly crashes. I would be inputting a journal entry and then the app crashes. I get so bummed because I invested my time into a solid journal entry and then the app crashes and I loose my entire written entry. Is there anything I can do to help fix this? 
Other than that, I am completely enjoying this app!
Wonderful app. It keeps me on task.

I HAVE FINALLY FOUND THE ONE. I’ve been searching for a decent app for my daily planning for a week now. After multiple unsatisfactory apps, I was losing hope. 
...But then Productivity came into my life! 

It has long-term goals with milestones (which I think is remarkable since I have a hard time reaching goals), further questions about those goals which really motivated and encouraged me to achieve them, and you can even add those goals to iPhone Calendar, iPhone Reminder, AND Google Calendar!

You can add activities which has amazing features including: repetition, time, duration, end date, tags, note, and a high priority switch!

It has a journal which includes a diary and a note taker! I personally don’t use the diary but I often use the note for something I can write down during the day.

There’s a morning planner and evening reflection! The planner makes you aware on what you need to get accomplished and the reflection is just amazing. It really helps you grasp everything you did and how you can improve your future planning. 

I steal one star for minor reasons. 
First, I couldn’t scroll down to change the number of times I wish to do an activity in a day. 
Second, instead of the high priority switch, why not implement a feature where you can choose the degree of the priority?
Third, I just personally think the layout is boring. I mean, it’s blue, black, and white all around. Why not implement an exciting layout with different fonts and colors when you can? Or at least have the option to. 

This is the longest review I have ever made, but I’d just like to say that I am so impressed. I would gladly pay a one-time charge at a reasonable price like $3-$5. Definitely recommending.

Won’t even let me sign up. I can’t complete sign up and the app doesn’t even say why, then when I click the link for support on this page I get a word document downloaded onto my phone that just says ‘app support.’ Is this a joke?

Organized Artist. This app has kept me focused and productive for the past month. I like the ability to plan ahead so entry dates don't get lost and planning painting and volunteer work has added more valuable time to my day. Great tool.

Can’t even sign up. I tried to sign up for a new account and nothing happened. Tried to delete app and reinstall it still not able to sign up or sign in. 
What a let down. Glitches before I can even use it.
Couldn’t be better.... This app has everything needed to stay organized, accountable and informed on your progress. But, you are the most important factor.
Love this app!. Easy to use, simplicity and helps me focus!

Privacy Concern. I didn’t realize when I purchased this app that all of my tasks, goals, notes, etc goes on their server. For me, that’s unnecessary because I don’t need to sync any of this data to any of my other devices and especially not their server(s). Since this is a big deal to me, I have to give this app a low rating. Otherwise, it would have gotten a higher rating from me.
Great app. Keeps me organized and on top of my to do list. Easy to understand and follow! Love this app!

Good system still a lot of bugs. Good system for setting goals and keeping track of progress. Would be nice if you could prioritize tasks and organize them more independently. Still has a lot of calendar syncing problems with google and apple calendars. Limited features in terms of editing tags and setting calendar features.

Great app. This is a great All in one app. I have used it since it’s inception and continues to get better. It’s particularly helpful that includes everything regarding goals, tasks for the day as well as reminders. More recently they added a timer on to it which is also extremely helpful. Highly recommend

iOS Update 11.2.2 five-star response. After reporting this issue, it was resolved within a couple of hours. Great app support! (Is anyone else’s app shutting down after the latest update? App opens, goes to black screen, then returns to phone home screen.)
Great app. Simple and easy to use. Can keep track of my priorities and keep a journal.
Best application to help you organize. I love it!! This application will help me being focus on my goals everyday and to have my goals handy whenever I need to modify or to see how well I am doing😉
Amazing. Latest update is amazing.. more friendly more productive 👍🏻👍🏻

Real Productivity Booster. This app had been a game changer for me. 

I was testing all the Success Wizard suite of apps and still trying to decide between Productivity and Goals. 

Both apps provide a life planning process and a clear system to set goals, make an action plan and a daily to do list. It also includes a journal to take daily notes.

I feel much more organized now and I am getting much more done every day. This is huge for me.

I am getting ready for 2018 and I am sure the new app will be very useful and achieving my ambitious goal for next year.

Love!. I love this app. I am not paying for the full but I am still loving it and using it everyday. If it continues to be this great and help me remember and reach my goals I will be paying for the full version. Do not pass up this experience just because it’s a little limited in free mode. You can do more than you think. Take the time to learn all this app can really do. It’s amazing!

Love it!. Absolutely love this app, it really helps me stay productive and I love that you can use this for long term goals or as a diary as well. Would give it five stars if the layout (and especially icon!) were edited to look prettier😬
Pro is worth it. I really like the pro version of the app. It works for me and just really makes sense. The free version is enough to tell if it will be a good fit for you.
Love it. I really love this app. I've been using the basic version for several years and it has really helped me reach several goals. I finally broke down and bought the pro!

Helps keep my ADHD in control!. Several months ago I went on a search for the best productivity apps. I tried many and slowly whittled down to my the most useful ones. The UI/UX could be improved but the features and structure are perfect. I went a long while with the free version but the Pro version is definitely worth it since I use the app so much!

Life Changing Productivity app. This app has so helped me organize my two businesses, that each day I am able to produce many great results, while removing a lot of stress and ineffectiveness along the way. I highly recommend it for anyone with a long list of daily ideas and responsibilities to realize and fulfill.

Expensive. This app looked promising but you're limited to 3 tasks unless you upgrade to pro. This upgrade gives you all the usual pretend upgrades with the usual "pro" series that typical apps have, photos, unlimited items that you got the app to do anyway, colors, etc. difference being here, the Pro is $18.99! No unlimited use trials to see if it's something that might stick around and continue being useful or any other options.

It's a shame really. I would've liked to see a 30 day trial, if nothing else to see if the system would work for me. But instead I'm limited to 3, so I'm forced to say goodbye to this app, there are too many productivity apps out there to justify this price in my head.
Truly Great. I've tried other apps to get organized and plan my days, but this really works. It's like a personal assistant that makes all things better.

Extremely useful. I am writing this app five stars, despite the fact that it is a little glitchy because of its incredible usefulness. I've been using it for about a month now and it has helped me get on track with my goals like nothing else has. It is exactly what I was looking for: something that goes beyond the standard to do list and helps you organize yourself to accomplish long-term goals and stay on track with them. For that reason, I would say it is worth it's weight in gold.

Getting things done. I am an actual unpaid customer of the app, I say this because I read some reviews of apps sometimes and wonder the real motivation. So far in the time that I have been using this app, I find that it efficiently breaks down my long term goals into everyday actions. The reminders are awesome. Excellent BUT huge problems. The function is excellent, they really have thought of everything and it works perfectly. Here are the big problems from worst to least:
#1 - You have to sign up for an account, presumably so you can be integrated with other Success Wizard apps and your online or PC version which you do not have to have to use the app. This means every time you go into the app you have to log-in. Immediately I was concerned that all of my very personal goals, etc would not only be accessible to who-knows-who at their company but that it may be used to target market me. I was right. No less than one week after I signed up, I got mail (real snail-mail) from them pushing another one of their apps for exercise or fitness tracking.
#2 - Continuing with the privacy problems, there is no way to passcode this app. Anyone with access to your iPad can open the app and read all the juicy details (by the way, your login information is saved and pre-populated).
#3 - This last one is minor considering all the things this app has to offer, but the interface is ugly. It was clearly designed for the iPhone and just made bigger. So text is huge and it's very plain to look at. 
Even though the features and organization is awesome, I am not comfortable using it without standard privacy controls. By the way, Productivity Wizard and Success Wizard (both by the same company) are almost identical. The only difference I noticed was Success has a mood-analyzer while Productivity has a productivity-analyzer. It would be great if one app could have both so you don't need to use two.
